title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E9 — Everything's Coming Up Roses
Everything is coming up roses on Martha's Bedford farm; Martha is creating a brand-new rose garden with almost 200 roses; from color to fragrance, the inspired world of roses is a very good thing.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E10 — Azaleas, Hostas, and Wild Birds
Martha's azalea grove is bursting with the last flowers of spring; then everything you need to know about hostas; Martha takes up bird watching.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E3 — Magic Mushrooms
Martha learns about the magic of mushrooms; mushroom expert Andrew Carter explains each mushroom variety; Martha and mushroom cookbook author Andrea Gentl make delicious mushroom recipes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E6 — The Bagel Show
Martha samples bagel toppings and is joined by Gary Greengrass, owner of Barney Greengrass, an NYC staple; at PopUp Bagels, Martha makes bagels and constructs breakfast sandwiches with Adam Goldberg.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E8 — Vegan Cuisine Redefined
Martha and Chef Daniel Humm make redefined vegan dishes; Martha and Chef Daniel make a refreshing cocktail and gazpacho, followed by mushroom and seaweed baked rice and a rhubarb cobbler for dessert.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E9 — Authentic Greek Cuisine
Martha and Chef Costas Spiliadis of Estiatorio Milos make Taramasalata and salad; they build an eggplant and zucchini tower with tzatziki; then, they salt-bake a fish served with yogurt.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E8 — Paella on an Open Fire
Martha creates the perfect menu for a paella party that will have your guests coming back for seconds; her paella is served with gazpacho and her incredible sangria.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E4 — Chef David Burke's Modern Classics
Chef David Burke brings his modern classic dishes to Martha's kitchen; a bacon clothesline, calamari noodles, miso chicken with ginger and vegetables, and key lime pie are on the menu.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E6 — Sensational Summer Salads
Martha and Salad Freak author Jess Dameck reveal the art of constructing the perfect salad; Martha and Sarah Carey share a new twist on the classic Caesar salad and create a roasted beet salad.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S1 E19 — Urban Archaeology; Chocolate Curls and Cakes; Potpourri
Urban archaeology; chocolate recipes; potpourri; frozen cookie dough.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S1 E23 — Tomatoes; Raspberry Puree; Ice Cream; Dried Flowers
Growing tomatoes; raspberry purée; peach ice cream; dried flowers.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E3 — Baked Apples; Mesh for Glass; Freezing Berries
Window boxes; baked apples, replacing glass with mesh; raspberry trellis; freezing berries.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E6 — Halloween Pumpkins; Cookies; Costumes; Decorating
Carving pumpkins; Halloween cookies; costumes; face painting; decorating holiday door; trick or treaters at Turkey Hill.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E7 — Ribbon Lampshade; Rolled Linen; Photo Album; Video Boxes
Ribbon lampshade; freshly ironed tablecloth; customized photo albums.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E8 — Apple Pie; Pie Dough in Box; Antiquing Urns; Brussels Sprouts
Apple pie; antiquing urns; brussels sprouts; architectural salvage.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E11 — Poaching
Using poached chicken breast in chicken salad sandwiches and Cobb salad; poached salmon steaks; poached eggs.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E12 — Frying
French fries; pan-fried chicken; Japanese tempura vegetables with dipping sauces.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E1 — Perfect Roast
Rib roast; crown roast of pork; stuffed turkey breast; the best cuts for roasting.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E2 — Stewing
The basic elements of making a stew; beef stew; veal stew; coq au vin.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E6 — Pasta Sauces
Traditional pasta sauce; slow-cooked Bolognese; puttanesca; carbonara; a light sauce made with bottarga.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E7 — Fishmonger
Seafood chef Dave Pasternack explains buying, butchering and storing fish; boning a round or flat fish; cleaning a squid; crudo.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E11 — Martha's Garden Tours of Turkey Hill and Bedford
Martha visits her former home, Turkey Hill, where everything began for Martha in the 1970s; then back to her Bedford farm for a garden club tour - a peek inside Martha's gardens past and present.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E12 — Color For All Seasons
One of the joys of gardening is planning for beautiful color all through the year; bulbs and tubers are at the center of this show because of their beautiful blooms from spring to winter.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E1 — Martha's Easy Foundation Landscaping Project
Martha redesigns the foundation landscaping around one of the homes on her Bedford Farm, providing step-by-step instructions on how to complete a successful landscaping project with ease and intent.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E2 — Growing Citrus
Martha explores the incredible world of citrus from yuzus and kumquats to citrons and mandarins; Martha visits Flavors by Bhumi in her home state of New Jersey to learn all about growing citrus.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E3 — Getting the Garden Going
Martha prepares her garden for the season's splendor - from planting hellebores to propagating trees to proper lawn care; plus, succulent pots for early color.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E4 — Tropical Plants That Can Grow Anywhere
Martha travels to Florida for all things tropical plants; Martha explores inspiring gardens and landscapes in Palm Beach, highlighting diverse varieties of tropical plants that can be grown anywhere.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E5 — Container Gardening Made Easy
Martha shares the dos and don'ts of container gardening from choosing what to plant and the right container to sharing her key tips for nutrient-rich soil; a glossary of underplantings to give potted plants a finished look.

title: Martha Bakes

Flatbreads; blue cheese-pecan icebox crackers; cheesy cracker; thyme crackers sprinkled with sea salt.

Sticky toffee pudding with toffee sauce; mini apricot tartes Tatin; simple pear tart; no-knead bread with flavorful seeds.

Coconut-lemon cake; coconut cookies; coconut crunch cake; frozen coconut and roasted pineapple cake.

Souffle with passion fruit; mango upside-down cake; biscuit-topped raspberry-rhubarb cobblers.
